# UNFCCC
> The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change website for climate agreements, negotiations, implementation resources, data, and official conference information.

UNFCCC.int is the central source for the Convention, Kyoto Protocol, Paris Agreement, COP and subsidiary body sessions, national reporting, climate action initiatives, and support for implementation under the international climate regime.

## Core Agreements and Process
- [What is the UNFCCC?](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/what-is-the-united-nations-framework-convention-on-climate-change): Overview of the Convention, its purpose, and the international climate process.
- [The Convention](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/the-convention/what-is-the-united-nations-framework-convention-on-climate-change): Background and key elements of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change.
- [Kyoto Protocol](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/the-kyoto-protocol/what-is-the-kyoto-protocol): Introduction to the Kyoto Protocol and its commitments framework.
- [Paris Agreement](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/the-paris-agreement/what-is-the-paris-agreement): Overview of the Paris Agreement, goals, and implementation architecture.
- [Process and Meetings](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings): Hub for negotiations, governing bodies, sessions, and official meeting information.
- [Bodies](https://unfccc.int/process/bodies): Information on COP, CMA, CMP, subsidiary bodies, and constituted bodies.

## Conferences and Meetings
- [Conferences and Meetings Overview](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/conferences-and-meetings): Entry point for COPs, SB sessions, and related meetings.
- [COP 28](https://unfccc.int/cop28): Official page for COP 28 resources, decisions, and participation information.
- [COP 29](https://unfccc.int/cop29): Official page for COP 29 updates, logistics, and conference materials.
- [COP 30](https://unfccc.int/cop30): Official page for COP 30 information and preparatory resources.
- [Sessions](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/conferences-and-meetings/sessions): Information on annual and intersessional UNFCCC negotiating sessions.
- [Calendar](https://unfccc.int/calendar): Official calendar of UNFCCC meetings, events, and deadlines.

## Decisions, Documents, and Records
- [Documents and Decisions](https://unfccc.int/documents): Search and access official UNFCCC documents, decisions, and submissions.
- [Decisions Search](https://unfccc.int/documents?search2=&f%5B0%5D=type%3A1118): Filtered access to COP, CMA, and CMP decisions.
- [Meeting Documents](https://unfccc.int/documents?search2=&f%5B0%5D=type%3A1099): Official agendas, reports, and session documentation.
- [Submissions from Parties and Observers](https://unfccc.int/topics/adaptation-and-resilience/workstreams/national-adaptation-plans-naps/submissions): Public submissions related to specific workstreams and agenda items.
- [Notifications](https://unfccc.int/notifications): Official notifications, deadlines, and communications from the secretariat.
- [Archives](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/conferences/past-conferences): Access past conference pages and historical meeting records.

## National Reporting and Transparency
- [Transparency and Reporting](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/transparency-and-reporting): Overview of reporting obligations and transparency arrangements.
- [Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)](https://unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/the-paris-agreement/nationally-determined-contributions-ndcs): Information on NDCs under the Paris Agreement.
- [NDC Registry](https://unfccc.int/NDCREG): Official registry for nationally determined contributions.
- [National Communications](https://unfccc.int/topics/transparency-and-reporting/the-big-picture/introduction-to-transparency-and-reporting/national-communications): Guidance and resources on national communications.
- [Biennial Transparency Reports](https://unfccc.int/topics/transparency-and-reporting/the-big-picture/introduction-to-transparency-and-reporting/biennial-transparency-reports): Information on BTR requirements and submissions.
- [GHG Data Interface](https://di.unfccc.int/): Data interface for greenhouse gas inventories and related reporting data.

## Climate Action Topics
- [Topics](https://unfccc.int/topics): Main index of UNFCCC thematic areas and workstreams.
- [Adaptation and Resilience](https://unfccc.int/topics/adaptation-and-resilience): Resources on adaptation policy, planning, and implementation.
- [Mitigation](https://unfccc.int/topics/mitigation): Information on emissions reduction workstreams, policies, and mechanisms.
- [Loss and Damage](https://unfccc.int/topics/adaptation-and-resilience/workstreams/loss-and-damage-ld): UNFCCC work on averting, minimizing, and addressing loss and damage.
- [Climate Finance](https://unfccc.int/topics/climate-finance): Guidance and updates on finance under the Convention and Paris Agreement.
- [Technology](https://unfccc.int/topics/technology): Technology development and transfer under the UNFCCC process.
- [Capacity-building](https://unfccc.int/topics/capacity-building): Support, frameworks, and initiatives for climate capacity-building.
- [Gender](https://unfccc.int/topics/gender): Gender-responsive climate policy resources and work programme information.

## Markets and Implementation Mechanisms
- [Carbon Markets](https://unfccc.int/topics/mitigation/workstreams/markets-and-non-market-mechanisms): Overview of market and non-market mechanisms under the climate regime.
- [Clean Development Mechanism](https://cdm.unfccc.int/): Official portal for CDM rules, projects, and methodologies.
- [Joint Implementation](https://ji.unfccc.int/): Official portal for Joint Implementation mechanism information.
- [Article 6](https://unfccc.int/topics/mitigation/workstreams/article-6): Resources on cooperative approaches and Article 6 implementation.
- [REDD+](https://unfccc.int/topics/land-use/workstreams/reddplus): Information on REDD+ policy and implementation under the UNFCCC.
- [NAZCA / Global Climate Action](https://climateaction.unfccc.int/): Portal showcasing non-Party stakeholder climate action commitments.

## Data, Portals, and Tools
- [Data and Reports](https://unfccc.int/data): Access data products, reports, and analytical resources.
- [GHG Data Interface](https://di.unfccc.int/): Explore greenhouse gas inventory data submitted by Parties.
- [NDC Registry](https://unfccc.int/NDCREG): Registry of nationally determined contributions and related submissions.
- [Climate Action Portal](https://climateaction.unfccc.int/): Tracking and showcasing global climate action by non-Party stakeholders.
- [CDM Registry and Tools](https://cdm.unfccc.int/): Project, methodology, and issuance information for the CDM.
- [UNFCCC YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/unfccc): Official video channel with conference briefings and explainer content.

## News, Media, and Learning
- [Newsroom](https://unfccc.int/news): Official news, press releases, and announcements from the secretariat.
- [Press Corner](https://unfccc.int/press): Media resources, press materials, and accreditation-related information.
- [Events](https://unfccc.int/events): Public events, side events, and webinars across UNFCCC topics.
- [Climate Change Learning Partnership](https://www.uncclearn.org/): Learning resources and courses linked to climate policy capacity-building.
- [Momentum for Change](https://unfccc.int/climate-action/momentum-for-change): Recognition of climate action success stories and initiatives.
- [Resources for Journalists](https://unfccc.int/press/media-resources): Media guidance and background materials for reporting on UNFCCC processes.

## Participation and Constituencies
- [Observer Organizations](https://unfccc.int/process/parties-non-party-stakeholders/non-party-stakeholders/observer-organizations): Information for admitted observer organizations and participation rules.
- [Constituencies](https://unfccc.int/process/parties-non-party-stakeholders/non-party-stakeholders/constituencies): Overview of official UNFCCC observer constituencies.
- [Admission of Observer Organizations](https://unfccc.int/process/parties-non-party-stakeholders/non-party-stakeholders/admission-of-observer-organizations): Procedures and requirements for observer admission.
- [Parties](https://unfccc.int/process/parties-non-party-stakeholders/parties-convention-and-observer-states): Information on Parties to the Convention and observer States.
- [Non-Party Stakeholders](https://unfccc.int/process/parties-non-party-stakeholders/non-party-stakeholders): Participation framework for civil society and other stakeholders.
- [Election and Membership](https://unfccc.int/process/bodies/election-and-membership): Membership and election information for constituted bodies.

## About the Secretariat
- [About Us](https://unfccc.int/about-us): Overview of the UN Climate Change secretariat and its mandate.
- [The Executive Secretary](https://unfccc.int/about-us/the-executive-secretary): Information about the Executive Secretary and leadership role.
- [Secretariat Structure](https://unfccc.int/about-us/secretariat): Organizational information about the UNFCCC secretariat.
- [Careers](https://unfccc.int/about-us/careers): Employment and recruitment information for secretariat positions.
- [Procurement](https://unfccc.int/about-us/procurement): Procurement opportunities and vendor information.
- [Contact and Regional Collaboration Centres](https://unfccc.int/about-us/regional-collaboration-centres): Regional support centres and contact information.
